PermissionGroup.ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION: Allows apps to access your activity data, such as steps, physical activity like walking, biking, or running.

Permission.REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS: Allows app requests to ignore battery optimizations.
Permission.REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES: Allows applications to request installation of packages.
Permission.REQUEST_OBSERVE_COMPANION_DEVICE_PRESENC: Allows an app to request to observe the presence of a companion device.
Permission.REQUEST_PASSWORD_COMPLEXITY: Allows apps to request password complexity.
Permission.RESTART_PACKAGES: Allows apps to restart other apps.
Permission.RUN_USER_INITIATED_JOBS: Allows the app to run user-initiated jobs.
Permission.SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM: Allows apps to set precise alarms.
Permission.SEND_RESPOND_VIA_MESSAGE: Allows the app to send responses via messages.
Permission.SEND_SMS: Allows the app to send text messages.
Permission.SET_ALARM: Allows the app to set alarms.
Permission.SET_ALWAYS_FINISH: A global setting that allows apps to control 'Always end activity' (usually used in developer options).
Permission.SET_ANIMATION_SCALE: Allows the app to modify global animation scaling settings (usually used in developer options).
Permission.SET_DEBUG_APP: Allows app configuration to debug the app (usually used in developer options).
Permission.SET_PREFERRED_APPLICATIONS: Allows the app to modify preferred app settings.
Permission.SET_PROCESS_LIMIT: Allows the app to modify background process limits (usually used in developer options).
Permission.SET_TIME: Allows the app to set the system time.
Permission.SET_TIME_ZONE: Allows the app to set the system time zone.
Permission.SET_WALLPAPER: Allows the app to set wallpaper.
Permission.SET_WALLPAPER_HINTS: Allows the app to set wallpaper hints.
Permission.SIGNAL_PERSISTENT_PROCESSES: Allows an application to send signals to persistent processes.
Permission.SMS_FINANCIAL_TRANSACTIONS: Allows the app to access text messages involving financial transactions.
Permission.START_FOREGROUND_SERVICES_FROM_BACKGROUN: Allows the app to start foreground services in the background (requires companion device).
Permission.START_VIEW_APP_FEATURES: Allows the app to launch view app functionality.
Permission.START_VIEW_PERMISSION_USAGE: Allows apps to launch view permission usage.
Permission.STATUS_BAR: Allows the app to turn on, turn off, or disable the status bar.
Permission.SUBSCRIBE_TO_KEYGUARD_LOCKED_STATE: Allows the app to subscribe to lock screen state changes.
Permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW: Allows an app to display a window on top of other apps (floating window permission).
Permission.TRANSMIT_IR: Allows an app to transmit data via an infrared transmitter.
Permission.TURN_SCREEN_ON: Allows the app to open the screen.
Permission.UNINSTALL_SHORTCUT: Allows apps to uninstall shortcuts in the launcher.
Permission.UPDATE_DEVICE_STATS: Allows the app to update device statistics.
Permission.UPDATE_PACKAGES_WITHOUT_USER_ACTION: Allows an app to update packages without user interaction.
Permission.USE_BIOMETRIC: Allows the app to use device-supported biometric hardware (e.g. fingerprint, facial recognition).
Permission.USE_EXACT_ALARM: Allows apps to use the Precision Alarm API (in Android 13+).
Permission.USE_FINGERPRINT: Allows the app to use fingerprint hardware.
Permission.USE_FULL_SCREEN_INTENT: Allows apps to use full-screen intents to show activity on the lock screen when important notifications are received.
Permission.USE_ICC_AUTH_WITH_DEVICE_IDENTIFIER: Allows apps to use ICC authentication with device identifiers.
Permission.USE_SIP: Allows the app to use the SIP protocol for Internet phone/video sessions.
Permission.UWB_RANGING: Allows applications to use ultra-wideband (UWB) technology for precise ranging.
Permission.VIBRATE: Allows the app to access the vibrator.
Permission.WAKE_LOCK: Allows apps to use PowerManager WakeLocks to prevent the processor from sleeping or the screen from dimming.
Permission.WRITE_APN_SETTINGS: Allows the app to write access point name (APN) settings.
Permission.WRITE_CALENDAR: Allows the app to write the user's calendar data.
Permission.WRITE_CALL_LOG: Allows the app to write (modify) the user's call history.
Permission.WRITE_CONTACTS: Allows the app to write (modify) the user's contact data.
Permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE: Allows the app to write to files in external storage (legacy permission, often replaced by MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE, etc.).
Permission.WRITE_GSERVICES: Settings that allow apps to write to the Google Services Framework.
Permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS: Allows an app to modify system security settings (usually only system apps).
Permission.WRITE_SETTINGS: Allows the app to read and write system settings (such as brightness).
Permission.WRITE_SYNC_SETTINGS: Allows the app to write sync settings.
Permission.WRITE_VOICEMAIL: Allows the app to write to voicemail messages on the system.

ChinesePhoneSpecialPermission.BACKGROUND_POPUP: Allows the app to display pop-ups in the background. This is a special permission for domestic Android phones (Xiaomi, Huawei, OPPO, VIVO, etc.) to display notification or warning windows without interrupting the user.
ChinesePhoneSpecialPermission.LOCK_SCREEN: Allows the app to display the interface when the screen is locked. This is a special permission for domestic Android phones (Xiaomi, Huawei, OPPO, VIVO, etc.) to display emergency information or control interfaces when the device is locked.
